obligations.note: The new route POST /payees/{id}/reopen maps to the privileged action manage_payees but is declared mfa=False in routes.py. The exhaustive control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails on head, naming exactly this route.
The new LedgerService.reopen_payee calls _audit(actor, 'reopen_payee', 'payee:{id}'), which records actor, action, target and clock time. The sampled audit control test passes on head.
Store.reopen_payee only updates status and closed_at and writes no NPI column. test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest (exhaustive) passes on head.
The new statement in Store.reopen_payee is a fixed string literal with payee_id bound as a parameter. test_sql_statements_are_parameterized (exhaustive) passes on head.
Ticket CHG-26118 is approved by change manager Erik Brandt (2026-10-21), before the change opened. Its components (payments.http, routes, service, store) cover all four touched files.
Mara Costa approved the code review on the head commit. She is a payments change_approver and a different person from the author, Sofia Santos.
The change has a single commit, and both approvals name it (17149d1).
The CI run on head has result 'failure', with 1 of 172 tests failing: the registered MFA-1 control test. The JUnit hostname (a personal Mac) also does not match the recorded CI executor.
The change touches security-sensitive components (payments.http, routes, store). Kofi Mensah, a security_reviewer, approved the security review on the head commit.

EXC-0222 is approved by a risk owner, unexpired and scoped to MFA-1 / payments.routes. But its scope is the reconciliation batch account only, while the code exempts every manage_payees user (e.g. payments_officer) from MFA. The described compensating control is also not implemented, so the deviation exceeds the exception.
Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1, covers routes.py) has lapsed because routes.py changed in behaviour. The replacement evidence, the exhaustive control test on head, fails.

summary: The change adds a privileged manage_payees route without MFA. The exhaustive MFA-1 control test fails on the head commit, so the CI run is a failure. The cited exception EXC-0222 covers only the reconciliation batch account, but the route is exposed without MFA to every role holding manage_payees, so the deviation is not within the exception's scope. Prior MFA-1 evidence has lapsed and has no passing replacement. The change must be rejected.
